title: Add built‑in response compression middleware
description: Provides transparent gzip/deflate compression for response bodies when the client supports it, reducing bandwidth and latency without external dependencies. The middleware auto‑detects content types, respects already‑compressed streams, and integrates with existing routing and error handling.
testCases: Compresses JSON response when `Accept-Encoding: gzip` is present and adds `Content-Encoding: gzip` header
Leaves response uncompressed when client does not send `Accept-Encoding` header
Skips compression for already compressed content types (e.g., images, already gzipped streams)
Handles errors in the compression stream without crashing the server
acceptance: All test cases pass, middleware can be added via `app.use(compression())`, compressed responses are correctly decompressed by the client, response headers and status codes remain unchanged, and no unhandled exceptions occur under high load.
reason: Bandwidth savings and faster page loads are critical for production workloads. Adding native compression eliminates the need for external middleware packages, keeping yantraverse zero‑dependency while delivering a high‑impact performance improvement.
